18  package org.apache.shardingsphere.database.exception.firebird.vendor;
19  
20  import lombok.Getter;
21  import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
22  import org.apache.shardingsphere.database.exception.firebird.sqlstate.FirebirdState;
23  import org.apache.shardingsphere.infra.exception.external.sql.sqlstate.SQLState;
24  import org.apache.shardingsphere.infra.exception.external.sql.sqlstate.XOpenSQLState;
25  import org.apache.shardingsphere.infra.exception.external.sql.vendor.VendorError;
26  import org.firebirdsql.gds.ISCConstants;
27  
28  /**
29   * Firebird vendor error.
30   *
31   * <p>Kernel {@code ShardingSphereSQLException} types, such as metadata column-not-found errors from the binder, are
32   * converted before the Firebird SQL dialect mapper is reached. They need a separate Firebird remapping path instead of
33   * enum entries here.</p>
34   *
35   * @see <a href="https://www.firebirdsql.org/file/documentation/chunk/en/refdocs/fblangref40/fblangref40-appx02-sqlcodes.html">SQLCODE and GDSCODE Error Codes</a>
36   */
37  @RequiredArgsConstructor
38  @Getter
39  public enum FirebirdVendorError implements VendorError {
40      
41      UNAVAILABLE_DATABASE(FirebirdState.UNAVAILABLE_DATABASE, ISCConstants.isc_unavailable, "%s"),
42      
43      DATABASE_ALREADY_EXISTS(XOpenSQLState.GENERAL_ERROR, ISCConstants.isc_db_or_file_exists, "%s"),
44      
45      INVALID_BATCH_HANDLE(FirebirdState.INVALID_BATCH_HANDLE, ISCConstants.isc_bad_batch_handle, ""),
46      
47      BATCH_TOO_BIG(FirebirdState.BATCH_TOO_BIG, ISCConstants.isc_batch_too_big, ""),
48      
49      DYNAMIC_SQL_ERROR(XOpenSQLState.SYNTAX_ERROR, ISCConstants.isc_dsql_error, "%s"),
50      
51      TABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS(XOpenSQLState.DUPLICATE, ISCConstants.isc_dyn_dup_table, "%s"),
52      
53      LOGIN_FAILED(XOpenSQLState.INVALID_AUTHORIZATION_SPECIFICATION, ISCConstants.isc_login, ""),
54      
55      LOGIN_ERROR(XOpenSQLState.INVALID_AUTHORIZATION_SPECIFICATION, ISCConstants.isc_login_error, ""),
56      
57      CHARSET_NOT_FOUND(FirebirdState.CHARSET_NOT_FOUND, ISCConstants.isc_charset_not_found, "CHARACTER SET %s is not defined"),
58      
59      INVALID_STATEMENT_HANDLE(FirebirdState.INVALID_STATEMENT_HANDLE, ISCConstants.isc_bad_stmt_handle, ""),
60      
61      INVALID_TRANSACTION_HANDLE(FirebirdState.INVALID_TRANSACTION_HANDLE, ISCConstants.isc_bad_trans_handle, ""),
62      
63      EXCESS_TRANSACTIONS(XOpenSQLState.GENERAL_ERROR, ISCConstants.isc_excess_trans, "attempt to start more than %d transactions"),
64      
65      BATCH_ALREADY_OPENED(FirebirdState.BATCH_ALREADY_OPENED, ISCConstants.isc_batch_open, ""),
66      
67      INVALID_BATCH_PARAMETER_VERSION(XOpenSQLState.DATA_EXCEPTION, ISCConstants.isc_batch_param_version, "Wrong version of batch parameters block %d, should be %d"),
68      
69      BATCH_PARAMETERS_REQUIRED(FirebirdState.BATCH_PARAMETERS_REQUIRED, ISCConstants.isc_batch_param, "Statement used in batch must have parameters"),
70      
71      SQLDA_ERROR(FirebirdState.SQLDA_ERROR, ISCConstants.isc_dsql_sqlda_err, ""),
72      
73      INVALID_SEGSTR_HANDLE(XOpenSQLState.SYNTAX_ERROR, ISCConstants.isc_bad_segstr_handle, "invalid BLOB handle"),
74      
75      INVALID_SEGSTR_ID(XOpenSQLState.SYNTAX_ERROR, ISCConstants.isc_bad_segstr_id, "invalid BLOB ID"),
76      
77      CANNOT_UPDATE_OLD_BLOB(XOpenSQLState.SYNTAX_ERROR, ISCConstants.isc_cannot_update_old_blob, "cannot update old BLOB"),
78      
79      INVALID_SEGSTR_TYPE(XOpenSQLState.SYNTAX_ERROR, ISCConstants.isc_bad_segstr_type, "invalid BLOB type for operation");
80      
81      private final SQLState sqlState;
82      
83      private final int vendorCode;
84      
85      private final String reason;
86  }
